images.module_banners: User-supplied concept artwork; supplied filenames retained in this manifest. Not representations of exact UI or actual game mechanics.
images.screenshots: Captured from the local DrawSplat repository on 2026-10-31; live tool registry matched local registry.
images.primary_badge: Built-in image_gen output, purple/gold inverted triangle; generation prompt stored in badge-generation.txt.

videos: Original narrated visual mini-lessons authored for this course. Synthetic English speech, genuine app screenshots, instructional slides, burned-in captions, WebVTT and HTML transcripts. Not live screen recordings.

clarity: Teacher clarity — Visible Learning MetaX, February 2026

The current MetaX entry reports a weighted mean effect size of 0.85 for teacher clarity. Its underlying syntheses concern relationships between clarity and learning; the figure is not a forecast of gains from a particular app.
feedback: Wisniewski, Zierer & Hattie (2020), The Power of Feedback Revisited

This meta-analysis reports d = 0.48 after excluding extreme values. A high-information-feedback subgroup reports d = 0.99. The subgroup is not interchangeable with the overall estimate, and effects vary widely.
retrieval: Yang et al. (2021), Testing (Quizzing) Boosts Classroom Learning
A review of 222 classroom studies reports an overall Hedges’ g of 0.499 for quizzing. Comparators, timing and feedback matter; typing a displayed answer is not the same task as recalling it.
selfexplain: Bisra et al. (2018), Inducing Self-Explanation: A Meta-Analysis
The study reports an overall weighted mean g = 0.55 for prompted self-explanation. Ask learners to explain why a step or relationship makes sense, rather than simply narrating clicks.
metacognition: EEF summarizes this strand as high impact, averaging eight additional months of progress. Months of progress are a separate metric from d or g. Teach planning, monitoring and evaluation within subject learning.
collaboration: EEF reports five additional months on average, with limited evidence security. Structure participation and a shared goal; placing students at the same screen does not by itself create effective collaboration.

fictional_data: schoolyard-observations.csv is synthetic practice data, not real school measurements.
